description: Public offering of Crown petroleum and natural gas rights [] is a series of datasets listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Energy. Bi-weekly notices of public offerings of Crown petroleum and natural gas rights made during the 2002 calendar year. Coverage: Alberta. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Energy. Its tags are mineral rights, natural gas, petroleum and natural gas, public offering notices, public offerings. It offers 44 resource(s) in PDF, TXT, URI. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
